title: Flake report
description: Contract for the flake-report tool: tests ranked by failure count with a pass-after-retry ratio. NOT YET SHIPPED — there is no durable flake database today (CIApprovalStore keeps only current-session head-SHA sets; GithubCiPoller persists no history). This schema ships as the contract; the flake-report tool refuses to run until CI outcomes are durably recorded, per ticket #1459 ('do not ship a script over an empty file').

tests.description: Tests ranked by failure count, descending.

name.description: Test identifier, e.g. path:line or test module.

suspected.description: true when the pass-after-retry ratio suggests flakiness.
